title: No roller brush head, not great for carpet
text: No roller brush head, not great for carpet. This model doesn't include a roller brush head and wasn't very effective of some types of carpet especially for getting dog hair as a result of no brush. For hard floors it works really well and is very lightweight. The seller was very easy to work with for a speedy and convenient refund because I wasn't overall satisfied for my needs.
